reviews.text: Honestly the price is not bad for a nueter. They do not include any cone or antibiotics or any pain medication for after surgery. They gave my cat a pain med shot thats good for three days that is all. The shot is normal but the lack of extra medication was odd to me, when other places I have gone almost always include that. I have taken multiple animals to get fixed over the years and how this place handles their customers and procedures are terrible. We showed up and stood in line for 40 minutes for drop off. Once inside the check in was quick but the lady who checked us in did not save our information and had to call us an hour later to refill out the paperwork. When we picked up our cat we again stood in line for almost 30 minutes and some lady just walked right past the line and went in and was helped right away. I don’t normally care but we were already standing outside in the heat.  When it was finally our turn to come inside the lady tech just stared at us did not speak to us at all other than to give us the quickest shortest aftercare instructions. She made the experience so awful and I am sorry I trusted them to take care of my animal. Treat your customers better as it’s obvious this is normal for this place though just by looking at the reviews. Unorganized and rude is the short version on this place.

Wait time for walk in is crazy I waited almost 3 hours but its understandable and i cant complain because the staff was incredible with my kitten and gave him a treat and explained what was being done and what couldnt be done. Overall the vet was really nice and made me feel at ease after a previous visit at a different vet that didn't go as well. That previous vet felt rushed and like they just wanted money whereas here they seemed more helpful

I really enjoy bringing my pets here and appreciate the low prices. All of the staff is kind and helpful as well. However, I really dislike the fact that they make people wait outside in line. It’s really hot outside, and sometimes you can be standing in line for more than 30 minutes. I wish that they had a better system when it came to that.

I made an appointment last week for today 4/16/26 for 4:30 & 4:50 pm appointments. Didn’t get to the back room till about 5:15 pm when I made the appointment I requested It was for my dogs to get tested for parasites,with a fecal direct rotation, where they have to go back there and swab. I clearly stated that was my reason for the appointment. I don’t know why they didn’t call me to tell me they couldn’t accept my appointment because they don’t do that, before I wasted almost an hour there. as I’m speaking with The technician, I’m telling her my dogs are vaccinated already as of this month & I wanted to see if they can get tested. She states they don’t do that. They just do the preventative care and they can give me medication. I declined, because I actually wanted to know if my pets were positive or not negative. So they didn’t get an exam and we just left with disappointment. I don’t know why fecal test is listed under “services” when it’s not.

We had our miniature dachshund’s shots here when he was 9 weeks as well as his neutering when he was 9 months. The team was very professional and sweet to all of the dogs! They did a great job during both visits, we will be coming back!
Very reasonable pricing. Staff was friendly and courteous. Most importantly, extremely kind to my husky. Highly recommend.

It took me a while to write this review because I simply couldn’t find the words to express how grateful I am.

On May 16th, my beloved dog Blair was diagnosed with pyometra and urgently needed an emergency spay surgery to save her life. After exhausting every option available to me, I found myself in the heartbreaking position of not being able to afford the procedure. Feeling devastated and out of options, I made one last phone call—to Emancipet.

Kat answered the phone, and despite how emotional and distressed I was, she remained calm, compassionate, and reassuring. From the very beginning, I could tell she genuinely cared. In that moment, her kindness meant more than she will ever know. Thank you, Kat and Luis, for the compassion you showed me that day.

Not only did they help me navigate my options, but they were also able to connect me with a clinic that could fit Blair in quickly and perform the surgery at a fraction of the cost I had been quoted elsewhere.

Dr. Cook and the entire team at Emancipet Monroe Plaza were exceptional. They were professional, thorough, prepared, and most importantly, they took incredible care of my girl. Their expertise and compassion gave me confidence during one of the most stressful experiences I’ve faced as a pet owner.

What touched me most was that Dr. Cook even called on Sunday to personally check on Blair’s recovery. That level of care and dedication is something I will never forget.

Today, Blair is healthy, happy, and still with us because of the kindness, skill, and generosity of the Emancipet team. My family and I will be forever grateful. You were truly angels when we needed them most, and you saved my dog’s life.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Arrived at 2:50 PM for my 3:10 and 3:15 appointments and asked staff how to check in. I was rudely told to stand in the long line outside. After waiting 20 minutes, another person arrived, skipped the line, said she had an appointment, and was immediately let in.
When I told staff I also had appointments, they suddenly checked me in and told me to wait in my car.
Rude staff and completely inconsistent treatment of clients. Very unprofessional.
Management should review how this location handles appointments and client interactions because today’s experience was unacceptable.

Saturday I walked in to literally just buy some preventative for my dog (my dentist appt was over on this side of town). I’ve done this before at the Wayside location with no issue, but just happened to be closer to this location today. When I walk in the lady says “did you get a text [that it was my turn]?” And I tell her I wasn’t there for a service or to have my dog seen by the vet (hence bypassing the long line of people with waiting with their dogs). She was extremely rude in tone and facial expression when she proceeds to tell me that I have to wait in the line regardless. Demonstrated an extreme lack of regard for customer service. I then go to the other location and am literally in and out within 30 seconds with what I need, and there were people waiting with their pets. Why would I wait in a long line with people who are there for something completely different than me for a 30 second transaction that doesn’t require the vet nor my pets presence? Yall need to rethink that strategy and that lady needs to be addressed for her attitude. I won’t ever be returning to this location. Way better experience at the Wayside location.
